property_summary: Rule: Only the original admin (the deployer stored in admin) can call setOwner successfully; the mutant that checks msg.sender == owner allows non-admins who become owner to call setOwner after ownership transfer and thus can change owner again — breaking the invariant that only the initial admin can perform admin-only actions.
change_summary: Change the onlyAdmin require to compare against owner instead of admin, so only admin-only functions now require msg.sender == owner.
